mapper.sql: SELECT sys_bill_no, bill_no, sub_bill_from, sub_bill_to, cmpy, holder_acc, endorser_acc, endorser, amt, sign_date, bill_type, bill_scope, acceptor, drawer, payee, issue_date, due_date, summary, cust, amt_process, amt_receipt FROM z000_sd_pay_flow_bill
mapper.select:
SELECT a.sys_bill_no, a.bill_no, a.sub_bill_from, a.sub_bill_to, a.cmpy, a.holder_acc, a.endorser_acc, a.endorser, a.amt, a.sign_date, a.bill_type, a.bill_scope, a.acceptor, a.drawer, a.payee, a.issue_date, a.due_date, a.summary, a.cust, a.amt_process, a.amt_receipt, a.amt - a.amt_process - a.amt_receipt AS amtRemain FROM z000_sd_pay_flow_bill a
AND @S@ a.sign_date = signDate @E@ AND @S@ a.endorser_acc = endorserAcc @E@ AND @S@ a.endorser = endorser @E@ AND @S@ a.bill_no = billNo @E@ AND @S@ a.sys_bill_no = sysBillNo @E@ AND @S@ a.cmpy = cmpy @E@ AND @S@ a.holder_acc = holderAcc @E@ AND @S@ a.amt = amt @E@ AND @S@ a.bill_type = billType @E@ AND @S@ a.bill_scope = billScope @E@ AND @S@ a.issue_date = issueDate @E@ AND @S@ a.due_date = dueDate @E@ AND @S@ a.cust = cust @E@
ORDER BY a.sys_bill_no DESC
WHERE holder_acc = #{holderAcc} AND bill_no = #{billNo} AND sub_bill_from = #{subBillFrom} AND sub_bill_to = #{subBillTo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO z000_sd_pay_flow_bill (sys_bill_no, bill_no, sub_bill_from, sub_bill_to, cmpy, holder_acc, endorser_acc, endorser, amt, sign_date, bill_type, bill_scope, acceptor, drawer, payee, issue_date, due_date, summary, cust, amt_process, amt_receipt) VALUES (#{sysBillNo}, #{billNo}, #{subBillFrom}, #{subBillTo}, #{cmpy}, #{holderAcc}, #{endorserAcc}, #{endorser}, #{amt}, #{signDate}, #{billType}, #{billScope}, #{acceptor}, #{drawer}, #{payee}, #{issueDate}, #{dueDate}, #{summary}, #{cust}, 0, 0)

INSERT INTO z000_sd_pay_flow_bill (sys_bill_no, bill_no, sub_bill_from, sub_bill_to, cmpy, holder_acc, endorser_acc, endorser, amt, sign_date, bill_type, bill_scope, acceptor, drawer, payee, issue_date, due_date, summary, cust) VALUES
(#{item.sysBillNo}, #{item.billNo}, #{item.subBillFrom}, #{item.subBillTo}, #{item.cmpy}, #{item.holderAcc}, #{item.endorserAcc}, #{item.endorser}, #{item.amt}, #{item.signDate}, #{item.billType}, #{item.billScope}, #{item.acceptor}, #{item.drawer}, #{item.payee}, #{item.issueDate}, #{item.dueDate}, #{item.summary}, #{item.cust})
mapper.update: UPDATE z000_sd_pay_flow_bill SET endorser_acc = #{endorserAcc}, endorser = #{endorser}, amt = #{amt}, sign_date = #{signDate}, bill_type = #{billType}, bill_scope = #{billScope}, acceptor = #{acceptor}, drawer = #{drawer}, payee = #{payee}, issue_date = #{issueDate}, due_date = #{dueDate}, summary = #{summary}, cust = #{cust} WHERE sys_bill_no = #{sysBillNo}
